about: Step 6, temp book staging/world.js (Mid's 10-world*, the map-maker and a new game): every piece. in v100: already home. bring: comes with its feature, as book entries and laws, Mid's values kept. cut: v100's own map-maker (DICTIONARY) or frames do the job. A piece that meets Albert's calls is in misfits.

makeCitadel: held: the Throne's walled citadel on the great lake's island; the Throne comes back reimagined (DICTIONARY Later); see misfits
FOREST: Mid's forest lattice, paths and lanes; v100's woods (TF1: a wall round every home at D50 with the road through it, patches over Z4)
TREE: a tree blocking 3 × 3 squares, deep at 6 neighbours; v100: one tree a tile of woods, deep at eight (deepen)
nodeScale: F14: PN1 left: a find drawn left[0] + left[1] × the share left
findRoom: room kept round a find by kind; v100's room from each shell (KIND r) and clear()
segGap: distance from a point to a segment; index.html segDist
openWays: nothing walled in: a find cut off by trees gets a way cut home through the woods; v100's map-maker has no such check
wayHome: finds that way: the fewest trees between a find and its home, never across water (with openWays)
QUARTER: a corner's quarter in Mid's land frame; v100's corners and zones (corner(), Z1–Z4, L11, L12)
ROOM: how near each laid thing may come to each kind; v100's rooms from the shells and the Randomizer's rules (L13)
takenGap: gap to what is already laid; v100's clear() and free()
turnLand: turns Mid's 45° land frame into the world; replaced by v100's frames (A1, QBD)
navOffLand: squares off the land are solid; in v100 the sea is in the height field (walkable)
layMovers: the start: v100's makeUnits places D67 villagers round the Town Center and herds in Z4; Mid also gives each side first jobs, a scout, deer and a boar near home, and a chest, ruins, wolf den, cemetery and drifters' camp each corner (where: by v100's zones)
layCamps: a robbers' camp each side of the map (with the outlaws, MH); where: by v100's zones
wildAt: index.html spawn() with side −1; Mid's home point and a find's guard come with addFind
addFind: a find with its guards (wolves round a den) or hired drifters; v100's put() lays the gifts. Its fantasy guards: see misfits
SHAPE: Mid's bush and pair offsets; v100's cluster() takes the nearest free tiles
LAYOUT: Mid's ring of distances a find from the keep; v100's zones Z1–Z4 and D70–D81 place them
SEEK: the search for room; v100's spot() tries
laySpots: places finds in Mid's rings; v100's makeThings and the Randomizer (L13)
makeMap: (Albert 11:16: bring, clean) Mid's map-maker; v100's makeGround, makeTerrain, makeThings. The land's character per game: see misfits
SHORE: squares counted as shore; v100's coast and lakes in the height field (D.shore)
lakeFor: the lakes the walking grid was drawn for; v100 reads water from the height (L5)
lakeR: a lake's radius; v100's lakes are cuts in the height field (TC1)
lakeRAt: a lake's shore by harmonics; v100's fractal shore (QAZ)
shoreWalk: traces a shore; v100's lakes live in the height field
shorePath: v100's lakes live in the height field
onLand: v100: a tile is land by its height (L5); the Throne's island and causeways wait with the Throne
lakeGap: distance to the nearest lake; v100's terrain keeps its own rules (between())
lakeGrid: (Albert 11:16: bring, clean) water on the walking grid, flood water wadeable with levees; v100's walkable() reads the height (L5). The flood: see misfits
lakeSize: the lake-size power law; v100's QBH, the same Pareto draw
riverRuns: a river's stretches for painting; v100 paints the height field
layFish: F16: index.html floor 3, round every lake's shore (E344); the rivers' fish wait for rivers kept as a list (Parked)
G: Mid's one game object; v100 keeps its state in things, units, SIDES, K and SEEN (the FK door)
blankGame: a new game's blank state; v100's start() resets; each field (mail, milestones, truce, hazards) comes with its feature
mkPlayer: a side's record: v100's SIDES has colour and store; age, research, relations, the crowns' tally and the computer's state come with their features
newGame: a new game: v100's start() (seed of the day QBF, the opening view QBW); the hazards drawn each game, the scenario and the computers' handicap come with their features: see misfits · Albert 11:16: no computers' handicap
applyScenario: a scenario: an age, a store, relations, buildings already up (v100's Start page lists Open, Siege, Silk Road, Last Keep, not built)
inBox: a point in a box; v100 tests its own bounds inline
node: index.html put(): a find on a tile, its amount from its shell
mkBld: index.html build(): n × n tiles, Open or Closed; progress and health come with econ.js and combat.js

misfits: Mid builds the Throne's walled citadel on an island in the great lake at the middle; v100 keeps the middle clear until you describe the Throne again. Leave Mid's out?
A find's guards can be fantasy beasts when fantasy is on; the fantasy is cut. Real guards only?
Mid rolls a character for each map (rich in one thing, poor in another, one extra find), so maps feel different; v100's map-maker has none. Add it to Z4's Randomizer?
The flood (lakes rising over the shore, waded with levees) is held (KI4). Keep it waiting?
Each computer starts with a free mill and farm (EXCEPTIONS #16, a live test); Parked.md has your idea to replace it with pressure. Bring the handicap or not?
